assets.prompt: Create one finished 16:9 film frame, a physical opaque GOUACHE AND CHARCOAL PAINTING ON COARSE IVORY PAPER. This is an intentional MEDIUM TRANSFORMATION, especially every face. Translate the recognizable facial proportions into 6–10 large angular paint shapes per cheek and forehead, ochre/rust/violet shadow planes, visibly dry brush bristles across the nose and jaw, broken charcoal eyebrow and eyelid marks. Paint irises and lips with 2–3 simple matte brush marks. Exposed paper grain appears THROUGH the skin shadows, not merely overlaid after rendering. Coarse consistent brush scale across face, neck, hands, clothes and environment. Faces must be as visibly handmade and simplified as the room. Do NOT reproduce photo-real skin from reference: no photographic detail, pores, skin smoothing, polished 3D, airbrush gradients, glossy doll eyes, beauty retouch, plastic shading, cinematic-photo depth of field, photomontage. Referenced sheets specify identities and locations only, not finish or layout. Single continuous composition, no panels, no frame border, no captions, letters or watermarks. Preserve age, ethnicity, overall face proportions and wardrobe while decisively simplifying facial rendering. Character identity is reference1 Luna, the SAME fictional 15-year-old girl, warm brown skin, brown eyes, dark curly LOW ponytail and flyaway curls, charcoal oversized plain T-shirt and PLAIN SOLID olive cargo trousers. No jewellery, no orange accessories, no adult makeup. Reference2 is the D06 attic architecture: exposed sloping wood rafters, warm brick gable, open window at LEFT, antique open wooden trunk, right timber post. Medium close shot waist-up of Luna seated on an ordinary wooden chair beside the trunk, body gently three-quarter toward camera; head turned to SCREEN RIGHT toward her mother's offscreen voice with a small thoughtful smile, lips closed, eyes alive but simply painted. Natural adolescent proportions. Her face occupies about a fifth of the width, near center-left. Camera at seated eye level. One relaxed hand rests on her knee, no other props held. Warm painted light from left on face and shoulder; cool violet-brown shaded face side, a few clear large paint strokes. The room stays a softly simplified gouache composition, NOT blurred photography. One person only. Leave right-side breathing room for her eyeline.

qa.positive: Visible ochre and violet-brown painted face planes; charcoal edges consistent with attic, limbs and clothing.
qa.limitations: Face reads slightly older/more mature than CC01G. Initial gaze is screen-left despite requested screen-right. Attic trunk position is changed with new camera view. Image is a style trial, not cast approval.
